title: Pricing Memorandum: Amount Carried to Formal Review on a Late-Filing Reconsideration of a TRICARE Select Line
content:
Appeals pricing memorandum — Appeals and Grievances

Subject: the amount carried to the next level when a formal review is asked for on a decided Claim Factual Reconsideration of a TRICARE Select line denied for late filing.

(a) The amount carried to the next level on a decided reconsideration of a TRICARE Select line denied for late filing is the payment at issue on the case's line — the claim line that is the subject of the case.

(b) The allowed amount at issue on the case's line is the amount the provider billed on it, divided for a nonparticipating provider by one plus the tier's nonparticipating balance-billing limit, rounded to the cent.

(c) The cost share on the case's line is the network outpatient cost-share percentage of the tier the case's line was billed under applied to the allowed amount at issue, or, under a tier that charges fixed network copayments and on a network line other than preventive care, that tier's network copayment for the service class, never more than the amount the cost share is figured on; it is rounded to the cent.

(d) The payment at issue is the allowed amount at issue less that cost share, rounded to the cent; that payment is the amount carried.

The records read are the case's own subject line, and on that line's TRICARE Select record its service date, claim number, provider, service class, billed amount, network status and the TRICARE Select enrollment it was billed under; the tier's figures are those of the TRICARE Select schedule.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Case's line billed 320.00 by a network provider for an urgent care visit, under a tier with a 20 percent network outpatient percentage: allowed amount at issue 320.00; cost share 64.00; payment at issue and amount carried 256.00. Billed instead by a nonparticipating provider under a hypothetical 15 percent balance-billing limit: allowed amount at issue 320.00 divided by 1.15, which is 278.26; cost share 20 percent of 278.26, which is 55.65; amount carried 222.61.
